subject: Request: Transitional quarterly invoicing for 6-month pilot (NovumTech)
messages:
From: Aisha Reynolds <aisha.reynolds@novumtech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Quarterly invoicing request for pilot — NovumTech

Hi Karthik (and Irene),

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement has asked that, for the 6-month pilot, we consolidate vendor billing to quarterly cycles to match our internal finance cadence. The ask is: quarterly invoices with Net-90 payment terms for the pilot period.

A few notes from procurement:
- We need invoices grouped by quarter (Jan–Mar, Apr–Jun, etc.) rather than monthly.
- Net-90 is standard for our vendor pilots to allow internal approval flows.
- We can sign a pilot addendum and provide a purchase order.

Attached is our procurement form (procurement_form_NovumTech.xlsx). Please let me know what approvals you need internally and whether Redwood can accommodate this for the pilot. If there are guardrails (caps, prepayments), we can discuss.

Appreciate a quick read — our kickoff ideally starts the week of May 10.

Best,
Aisha Reynolds
Senior Procurement Manager, NovumTech
Aisha.Reynolds@novumtech.com
procurements@novumtech.com

Attachment: procurement_form_NovumTech.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterly invoicing request for pilot — NovumTech

Hi Aisha — thanks, received.

We can start by escalating to Deal Desk/Finance to assess risk and approvals. A couple of clarifying questions to speed things up:
- Is the pilot value expected to be under $150k total? If higher, we'll need exec approval.
- Do you require the first quarter to be invoiced at signature or at month-end?
- Can you confirm the PO timeline (when will PO be issued)?

Irene / Jonas — looping you in to review. Aisha attached an internal procurement form and mentioned the pilot kicks off mid-May. I can propose conditional quarterly billing for the 6-month pilot if Finance is comfortable with a credit cap or a first-quarter invoice.

Aisha — I can assemble a short terms addendum for signatures (MSA already has the baseline). If Finance prefers, we can require a refundable usage credit or a partial prepay as a guardrail.

Next steps: I'll wait for Finance guidance and then share a one-page addendum.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: novum_msa_draft_v2.pdf (MSA draft stub)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Escalation: NovumTech quarterly / Net-90 pilot request

Karthik / Jonas —

Escalating NovumTech's ask for internal approval. Summary and recommendation below for quicker exec review:

Summary:
- Request: Quarterly invoicing for a 6-month pilot with Net-90 payment terms.
- Account: NovumTech (prospective customer, strategic vertical).
- Estimated pilot TCV: ~$120k (per Karthik's estimate).

Risk & proposal (our suggested conditional approval):
- Approve quarterly invoicing with Net-90 for the pilot only (6 months).
- Add a refundable usage credit cap of $150k to limit exposure.
- Require the first quarter to be invoiced at signature OR a $25k deposit (Finance preference) — whichever Finance chooses.
- Include automatic reversion to monthly billing after pilot unless a separate commercial agreement is signed.

Rationale: preserves procurement's workflow (helps close) while bounding Redwood's credit exposure. Security/compliance noted no special data residency needs.

Please confirm if you can greenlight this as Deal Desk (Jonas) or if we need VP Finance / CRO sign-off. If approved, I'll draft the addendum and send to Aisha with DocuSign.

Thanks — Irene
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: conditional-terms-proposal.pdf (proposal stub)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: NovumTech quarterly / Net-90 pilot request

Irene —

I reviewed the numbers. With an estimated TCV of $120k, Finance is comfortable approving a conditional pilot under these terms:
- Quarterly invoicing, Net-90 for the 6-month pilot only.
- $150k exposure cap (refundable usage credit).
- Require first-quarter invoice to be issued at signature (preferred over deposit).
- Add a clause: if invoices are 30+ days overdue after Net-90, revert to prepayment and pause service.

I'll route this to VP Finance for courtesy sign-off; however, given the amount and the customer profile, we can proceed with the proposed addendum and DocuSign link once VP Finance confirms.

Jonas
Director, Deal Desk / Finance Partner, Redwood Inference
